---
title: "Thesis LaTeX Environment Bootstrap"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("tinytex", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tinytex")
if (!tinytex::is_tinytex()) tinytex::install_tinytex()
pkgs <- c(
  "babel-english",
  "xcolor",
  "colortbl",
  "float",
  "booktabs",
  "tabularx",
  "titlesec",
  "fancyhdr",
  "flafter",
  "listings",
  "xspace",
  "csquotes",
  "hyperref",
  "biblatex",
  "biblatex-ieee",
  "biber",
  "url",
  "lm",
  "psnfss",
  "epstopdf-pkg"
)
tinytex::tlmgr_install(pkgs)
```
